literal: As much as dug, springs up in a sand well; to people, as much as learned, springs up knowledge.
translation: In a sandy well, water springs up in proportion to the depth it is dug. For people, knowledge grows in proportion to the extent they learn.
modern: மணலில் தோண்டிய அளவுக்கு ஏற்பக் கிணற்றில் நீர் ஊறும். அதுபோல, மனிதர்கள் கற்கும் அளவுக்கு ஏற்ப அவர்களின் அறிவு வளரும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a simple, vivid analogy to explain the nature of learning. A well dug in sandy soil yields water proportionate to how deep one digs. Similarly, human knowledge is not fixed but expands exactly as much as one continues to learn. The words 'தொட்டனைத்து' (as much as dug) and 'கற்றனைத்து' (as much as learned) perfectly balance the physical effort of drawing water with the mental effort of gaining wisdom.
